title: 金钱系统第二章 居然不是呆呆兽
content_zh:
真新镇大木研究所内，林萧正慢慢整理自己明天出发旅行的行李。
收拾好行李，站在窗边林萧默默的掏出一只廉价香烟点上火，注视着窗外。
不知道不觉自己来到这个世界已经5年了，联想起这五年的苦逼生活林萧不禁摇头苦笑。
自己对神奇宝贝世界并不追求，也不热爱，居然让自己莫名其妙的赶上了穿越大众，来到了这个地方。
况且这个世界也不如小时候看动漫那般美好，动漫中满10周岁的孩子就可以领取一只初始神奇宝贝和图鉴然后出发旅行。可动漫是美好的，现实却是残酷的。
那些能够领取到初始神奇宝贝的小孩子都是自己的父母从小给联盟缴税，每一年5万，10年也就是50万。如果不纳税的话，别说什么神奇宝贝，连屁都没有一个！
要知道不论哪个地区的初始神奇宝贝都是经过联盟慢慢培训出来的，无论培育基地、各种神奇宝贝食物、器材和员工的工资都需要大把的票子，要是免费发放的话，估计神奇宝贝联盟会亏得neiku都不剩下。
“林萧，你的行李准备好了吗？”一个50来岁穿着白大褂的老人站在门口问道。
林萧转身微笑道：“已经收拾好了大木博士，这5年来要感谢博士的收留了，否则我可能不知道饿死在哪个角落里了。”
“臭小子！”大木博士慈爱的搂着林萧的肩膀，狠狠的在他头上揉了两下笑骂道：“跟你说了多少遍，不准再说这种不吉利的话，当初我遇上了你也是我们之间的缘分。再说这5年来有你的帮助我感觉轻松了不少，要是小茂能有你这么乖巧能怪就好了。”
对于大木博士的话林萧感到很无奈，“博士，小茂他还小，等他长大了就能体会到你所说的一切了。”
“小个屁！”大木博士立马吹胡子瞪眼睛，“我刚把你带回研究所的时候你才10岁，不论洗衣服、做饭、喂养神奇宝贝每件事都做得妥妥当当的。小茂昨天就满10岁了，可他会干什么？不说什么难的，那家伙连自己的衣服都洗不干净！”
看着越说越激动的大木博士，林萧感到很无语，‘这一切还不是您老给宠溺出来的，再说自己上辈子就已经是20老几的人了，加上这一辈子都已经奔过30的人了，这能拿来和一个10来岁的富家少爷比的吗？’
察觉到林萧的沉默，大木博士尴尬的打了个哈哈，“唉~年纪大了就是话多，不知不觉有唠叨上了，你早点睡吧明天还要早起呢。”说着就朝门外走去。
看到大木博士要走林萧顿时急了，要知道林萧穿越附身的这具身体不知道是哪里的孤儿，简单的说也就是黑户。
在被大木博士收留，而且这心好的老头还帮助自己解决了户口的事情，但是由于没有缴税所以不能领取初始小精灵和图鉴。要知道没有图鉴这个相当于身份证的玩意就算你拥有神奇宝贝联盟也有权利给你没收，而且没有图鉴这玩意旅行不能参加任何正规的大赛。
虽然大木博士凭着自己的关系把林萧的身份落实，并帮他纳税，不过联盟还是有联盟的规定，只是看在他的面子上把时间缩短了5年，但是后果就是初始的神奇宝贝没有林萧的份。凭着大木博士的关系网多弄一只初始神奇宝贝也不算太难的事情，但人贵在要有自知自明。
“那个。。。。。大木博士，你明天能借我一只神奇宝贝吗？”
“借神奇宝贝？”大木博士面露为难之色，有些拿不定主意。
林萧忙道：“博士你会错意了，我说的是随便一只神奇宝贝都可以，并不是当初和你一起旅行的那几只。而且我只要达到常磐市就还给你，不会占用太久。”大木年轻的时候可是坐过天王的人，到现在身边还跟着几只老伙伴，分别是快龙、风速狗、耿鬼、妙蛙花。小茂一直对快龙和风速狗念念不忘，不过都被大木博士以各种理由拒绝了。

听了林萧的解释，大木博士笑道：“吓我一跳，我还以为你想借我那几只老伙伴呢。我明天会帮你选一只的，等你拥有了属于自己的神奇宝贝以后再还回来好了，夜深了，我老人家先去歇息咯。”说完连给林萧说谢谢的机会都没有，就转身离开了。
望着大木博士苍老的背影，林萧感到眼眶发胀，自己欠大木博士的恩情，这辈子都很难还清了。
强忍着差点流出的眼泪，林萧躺倒在床上，点了根烟调出了自己穿越福利系统。
宿主：林萧
男：15岁
身高：1.78米
拥有的神奇宝贝：无
拥有金钱：零
无敌金钱系统只有一个功能，那就是成为神奇宝贝训练师，不论和野生的神奇宝贝还是其他的训练家战斗胜利了都能够获得金钱。只要金钱足够就能在系统中买到自己中意的神奇宝贝，从绿毛虫到创世神都有。
最便宜的绿毛虫、独角虫、喇叭呀之类的要200个金币，列如小火龙、妙蛙种子、杰尼龟类的初始神奇宝贝则是1000金币。就连终极形态的都有，比如说由基拉的价格是3000，班吉拉价格是10000。
至于那些所谓的传说超神兽价格贵的惊人，光看那一票零就让人两眼打转。
不过这一切都是要以先成为训练家为前提的，这也就是林萧的倚仗，只要有时间让自己发展，绝对能把那些所谓的天王、冠军踩下去。
之所以会向大木博士借神奇宝贝，那也是被逼无奈，现在的林萧一穷二白，还欠着大木博士为自己纳税的50w票子。
自己抓的话。。。。。。别看自己快成年了，如果遇到野生神奇宝贝，一只bobo就能啄的自己鸡飞狗跳的到处跑，更别说抓了。再说yewai哪那么容易遇到好的神奇宝贝，就算遇到了也不一定打得过，到时候还不是一样鼓着眼睛看。
把烟头丢进烟灰缸里，林萧为自己定下了两个目标。
第一：尽快的拥有自己的神奇宝贝，然后把借来的还给大木博士。
第二：尽可能的想办法赚钱，先不说欠大木博士的债，就算自己旅行途中也要花钱，要知道满了15周岁以后就不能在神奇宝贝中心免费吃住了，那是为15岁以下的孩子准备的。
不论吃饭、住宿、都要自己掏钱，更别说神奇宝贝所需要的各种食物、药品了，这样一来也只能走精英路线了，神奇宝贝多了的话，准备饿死吧。。。。。。赚钱实乃重中之重！
想着想着，林萧便浑浑噩噩的睡了过去，但是明天的会是怎么样的，有谁知道呢。

content_en:
Inside the Damu Research Institute in Zhenxin Town, Lin Xiao was slowly packing his luggage for his trip tomorrow.
After packing his luggage, Lin Xiao stood by the window, silently took out a cheap cigarette, lit it, and stared out the window.
Unknowingly, it had been five years since he came to this world. Thinking of the hard life of these five years, Lin Xiao couldn't help but shake his head and smile bitterly.
I don't pursue or love the Pokémon world, so I somehow managed to catch up with the traveling public and come to this place.
Moreover, the world is not as beautiful as the cartoons we watched when we were children. In the cartoons, children who are over 10 years old can receive a starting Pokémon and a illustrated book and then start traveling. But animation is beautiful, but reality is cruel.
Those children who can receive the initial Pokémon have their parents paying taxes to the alliance since childhood, which is 50,000 per year, which is 500,000 in 10 years. If you don't pay taxes, let alone any Pokémon, there won't even be a fart!
You must know that the initial Pokémon in any region are slowly trained by the alliance. Regardless of the training base, various Pokémon food, equipment, and employee wages, a lot of money is needed. If they are distributed for free, it is estimated that the Pokémon Alliance will lose even Neiku.
"Lin Xiao, are your luggage ready?" an old man in his 50s wearing a white coat asked standing at the door.
Lin Xiao turned around and smiled: "I have taken care of Dr. Omu. I have to thank the doctor for taking me in these five years, otherwise I might not know where I would starve to death."
"Bad boy!" Dr. Omu lovingly hugged Lin Xiao's shoulders, rubbed his head twice and scolded with a smile: "How many times have I told you not to say such unlucky words again? It was fate between us when I met you. Besides, I feel a lot more relaxed with your help in the past five years. It would be great if Xiaomao could be as obedient and capable as you."
Lin Xiao felt helpless at Dr. Omu's words, "Doctor, Xiaomao is still young. When he grows up, he will understand everything you said."
"You little brat!" Dr. Ohmu immediately blew his beard and glared. "You were only 10 years old when I brought you back to the institute. You did everything properly, including washing clothes, cooking, and feeding Pokémon. Xiaomao turned 10 yesterday, but what can he do? Don't say anything difficult, that guy can't even wash his own clothes!"
Looking at Dr. Ohmu, who was getting more and more excited as he talked, Lin Xiao felt speechless, 'All this is not the result of your constant pampering. Besides, I was already in my 20s in my last life, and I have already passed 30 in this life. Can this be compared with a 10-year-old rich young master? ’
Sensing Lin Xiao's silence, Dr. Omu laughed awkwardly, "Oh~ As I get older, I tend to talk more, and I've started nagging me unconsciously. You should go to bed early. You have to get up early tomorrow." After saying that, he walked out the door.
Lin Xiao became anxious when he saw Dr. Oki was leaving. He must know that the body possessed by Lin Xiao through time travel was an orphan from somewhere. To put it simply, it was a black household.
After being taken in by Dr. Omu, the kind-hearted old man also helped him solve the household registration matter, but because he did not pay taxes, he could not receive the initial elves and illustrations. You must know that without a illustrated book, which is equivalent to an ID card, even if you own the Pokémon League, it has the right to confiscate it to you, and you cannot participate in any formal competitions when traveling without a illustrated book.
Although Dr. Oak relied on his connections to confirm Lin Xiao's identity and helped him pay taxes, the alliance still had alliance regulations. He just shortened the time by 5 years for his sake, but the consequence was that the initial Pokémon did not belong to Lin Xiao. It is not too difficult to get an additional initial Pokémon with Dr. Ohki's network, but the most important thing is to be self-aware.
"that... . . Dr. Oak, can you lend me a Pokémon tomorrow? "
“Borrow Pokémon? "Dr. Omu looked embarrassed, a little undecided.
Lin Xiao said hurriedly: "Doctor, you may have misunderstood. I am talking about any Pokémon, not the ones that traveled with you at the beginning. And I will return it to you as soon as I reach Joban City, so it won’t be occupied for too long. "Damu was a king of heaven when he was young, and he still has a few old friends with him, namely Kuailong, Wind Speed Dog, Gengar, and Bulbasaur. Xiao Mao has always been obsessed with Kuailong and Wind Speed Dog, but they were rejected by Dr. Damu for various reasons.
After hearing Lin Xiao's explanation, Dr. Omu smiled and said: "I was shocked, I thought you wanted to borrow some of my old friends. I will help you choose one tomorrow, and then come back after you have your own Pokémon. It's late at night, so I'll go and rest first. "After that, he turned around and left without even having a chance to say thank you to Lin Xiao.
Looking at Dr. Omu's old back, Lin Xiao felt his eyes swelled. The debt he owed to Dr. Omu would be difficult to repay in his lifetime.
Holding back the tears that almost flowed out, Lin Xiao lay down on the bed, lit a cigarette and called up his own travel welfare system.
Host: Lin Xiao
Male: 15 years old
Height: 1.78 meters
Pokémon owned: None
Money owned: zero
The invincible money system has only one function, and that is to become a Pokémon trainer. You can get money whether you win the battle with wild Pokémon or other trainers. As long as you have enough money, you can buy your favorite Pokémon in the system, ranging from green caterpillars to gods of creation.
The cheapest green caterpillars, unicorn bugs, horns, etc. cost 200 gold coins, while the initial Pokémon such as Charmander, Bulbasaur, and Squirtle cost 1,000 gold coins. There are even ultimate forms. For example, the price of Yukira is 3,000, and the price of Bangira is 10,000.
As for those so-called legendary super beasts, the prices are astonishingly expensive. Just looking at the zero votes makes people’s eyes spin.
However, all of this is predicated on becoming a trainer first. This is what Lin Xiao relies on. As long as he has time to develop himself, he can definitely defeat those so-called kings and champions.
The reason why he borrowed Pokmon from Dr. Oak was because he was forced to do so. Now Lin Xiao is completely broke and still owes Dr. Oak the 500,000 in tax money he paid for himself.
If you catch it yourself. . . . . . Even though I am almost an adult, if I encounter a wild Pokémon, a bobo will peck me and make me run around, let alone catch it. Besides, it's so easy for Yewai to encounter good Pokémon. Even if he encounters them, he may not be able to defeat them, so he won't be able to watch them with his eyes wide open.
Throwing the cigarette butt into the ashtray, Lin Xiao set two goals for himself.
First: Get your own Pokémon as soon as possible, and then return the borrowed ones to Dr. Oak.
Second: Try to find ways to make money as much as possible. Not to mention the debt you owe Dr. Oak, you have to spend money even when you travel. You must know that after you reach the age of 15, you cannot get free food and accommodation at the Pokémon Center. That is for children under 15 years old.
You have to pay for food and accommodation yourself, not to mention the various foods and medicines needed by Pokémon. In this way, you can only take the elite route. If there are too many Pokémon, prepare to starve to death. . . . . . Making money is the most important thing!
After thinking about it, Lin Xiao fell asleep in a daze, but who knows what tomorrow will be like.
